description: Trial-level spike count for every neuron, one row per (stimulus_id, trial) pair. M=80 neurons (columns).
Stimulus index for each row of spike_counts. Join with stimulus_grid.csv.
First stimulus feature coordinate (e.g. one axis of a 2-D structured stimulus space).
Number of repeated trials recorded at this stimulus.
Spike-count integration window used for every trial.
'fit' = intended for PCA-basis and decoder training. 'holdout' = reserved for validation; do not use these stimuli when fitting anything.
